retrievalProfile.description: A rustic, masculine portrait layout featuring a subject in denim against weathered wood with heavy, textured stencil-style display type.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a man in a denim shirt and camouflage cap, positioned off-center against a horizontal weathered wood backdrop, featuring large-scale textured block lettering and a secondary script subtitle.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned left-of-center to balance right-aligned typography
Texture of the denim and wood mirrored in the distressed fill of the display type
Warm, desaturated color palette unifying the subject and background
coreInvariants: Distressed or stenciled texture within the primary display font

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, medium close-up scale from chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large-scale block lettering on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, moves right to the large display text, then down to the script subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right-hand side of the wooden background serves as the canvas for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted blues and browns from denim and wood.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark charcoal or black for the primary textured text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white or cream for the script subtitle.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a warm, vintage-inspired tint; medium contrast.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and denim blues

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, condensed sans-serif and elegant script.
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a thick, blocky stencil-like skeleton with a distressed mesh texture fill.
Secondary text uses a fluid, slanted brush script with high contrast.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'G' and 'S' in the display type have sharp, squared-off terminals.
The script 'R' features a long, sweeping tail.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a heavy, masculine industrial block font with a refined, elegant script.

preserve: Distressed texture in the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky structure for the display text.
Captures the fluid, hand-written feel of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a denim shirt and camo cap against a horizontal weathered wood wall, using warm, desaturated tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, right-aligned block text with a distressed mesh texture in the upper right, followed by a white script subtitle below it.

verificationChecks: Does the main text have a distressed texture?
Is the color palette warm and desaturated?

adjustableVariables: Amount of distress in the typography
mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names or logos
Do not replicate the exact camouflage pattern

mustAchieve: Legible but heavily distressed display type

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text texture matches the rustic theme
Ensure the subject's lighting matches the background
Verify the script font is legible against the wood grain
recipe.reuseFormula: Rustic Portrait + Weathered Wood + Textured Stencil Type + Script Subtitle
